specificFindings: Typical meaning definition retains significance, purpose and coherence; well organized means divergent experiences fit guiding principles, not literal tidy possessions.

Graeber argument and job list retain attributed status; claims, most, secretly believe and probably are not converted to independently verified universal facts. Job judgements are distinguished from a whole life meaning.
Tend to preserves an aimlessness tendency, not a universal rule or inverse guarantee.
Commencement speech advice and biographies are not swapped with experiments; Michelle attribution is distinct from the source next paragraph original Michele spelling, which remains unchanged.
Dr Adams-Pickett figure retains over6000, twenty-year book-relative timeframe, Augusta and report to PBS; delivered babies is an obstetric contextual sense, not package delivery or controlled trial.
Might think of exceptional heroes is a common image, not a necessary qualification for meaningful lives. These and These people refer to the named achievers, not later survey respondents.
Meaning trap analogy does not claim all mechanisms identical; the second element concerns misunderstood requirements and is distinct from the first grand-ambition problem.
Do not necessarily fit retains uncertainty, not a claim that heroic images match none or all research.
The question-wording account retains One answer might, not a proven sole cause or proof that all self-reports are false.
Almost pointless is approximate semantic reasoning, not literal identity or a judgement of any reader life worth.
28.5 and54.9 remain different historical self-report categories, not verified hero counts or current population estimates.
Not simply a self-reporting bias rejects a sole explanation, not every possible reporting error; participants initially report own meaning, informants are separately asked.
Questions3,15,16 include exact context to interpret coherence and demonstrative references. Quoted fragments and ellipses retain original stable source IDs.
Bilingual options, answer-position spread and example grammar checked before publication.
limitations: This is a batch of ongoing whole-book work, not all gaps completed.
Stable source candidate IDs remain distinct from finalized manual sentence boundaries.
